line.comment: * If $virusName is specified, the hack is done by the player, otherwise, both $efficiency and $system must be specified.
* If target doesn't exist, return.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Counterhacks resolve after a delay. Player-launched hacks remain immediate.
* Target may have died during the delay.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Updated comments. Also, update accounting to steal red crystals from the player's outpost.
* Accounting. Add-Ons 1.13.2: Amount is now dependent on weighted ship relvalue.
* Smoother scaling of rel value similar to that from ZH.Sig.Captured.
* Maximum payout is 1.5M.
* Minimum payout is 1 red crystal worth.
* Add-Ons 1.13: No longer drops credits for OCV players. Now drops red crystals.
* If player is the target race, then destroy at least 1 red crystal from the player's Outposts.
* Report the actual burned amount later, if player has fewer crystals than what counterhack wants to burn.
* Player is not the target, so drop crystals.
* If player is the target race, steal money directly from the player. Station money is safe.
* If counterhack wants to steal more than what the player has, clamp.
* Player is not the target. Lovely money!
* Cargo.
* ZH 2.0 - we no longer eject equipment
* dim $maintypes = [SSTYPE_LASER], [SSTYPE_MISSILE], [SSTYPE_SHIELD], [SSTYPE_W_MINERALS]
* Cooling (Hull Damage)
* Navigation.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Sets the timeout here. If the target still has a timeout, then add the remaining time to the new timer.
* Navbug duration reduced from 100 seconds per 1% to 50 seconds per 1%.
* The NavBug tasks will start only if task 0 is not in use or NavBug isn't already running.
* Oxygen.
* ZH 2.0 - no longer checks for needed people in ship.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: START [NULL] on this script may lead to an extremely dangerous race condition by attempting to clone a ghost ship.
* Need to add flags to determine if bailing or destruction is in progress.
* Power (Shields)
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Now sets the outage (shields down) local variable here.
* If there is an existing timeout, extend the existing one which will be used by Task.PowerOutage. Otherwise, start the task.
* Radar (Weapons and Turrets).
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Now sets the blind local variable here. It now stores a timer rather than a boolean.
* If there is an existing timeout, extend the existing one which will be used by Task.Blind. Otherwise, start the task.
